# The Wire

> The Wire is a South Australian community radio network delivering independent news coverage on politics, social justice, health, environment, and indigenous affairs.

The Wire operates as a consortium of community radio stations providing daily news coverage, podcasts, and archives focused on South Australian and broader Australian current affairs. The site emphasizes investigative reporting on election coverage, policy analysis, and social issues affecting communities.

## Key Topics

- South Australia
- SA Politics
- Election Coverage
- Indigenous Affairs
- Housing Crisis
- Health Policy
- Environmental Issues
- Current Affairs
- Social Justice
- Community Radio Network
- Voice to Parliament
- Australian Politics
- First Nations
- Education News
- Podcast Distribution

## News & Current Affairs

- [South Australia Election Coverage](https://www.thewire.org.au/story/government-response-to-algal-bloom-under-fire-days-out-from-election): Government accountability reporting on algal bloom crisis ahead of SA election
- [Housing Crisis in SA](https://www.thewire.org.au/story/housing-crisis-in-sa-worst-in-a-generation): Analysis of South Australia's rental and housing crisis with Labor policy examination
- [State Voice to Parliament Election](https://www.thewire.org.au/story/effectiveness-of-the-state-voice-to-parliament-questioned-ahead-of-weekend-elections): Indigenous representation coverage examining State Voice to Parliament effectiveness
- [Healthcare Ramping Crisis](https://www.thewire.org.au/story/peak-medical-body-says-ramping-solvable-but-not-under-major-party-plans): Australian Medical Association analysis on healthcare ramping and election policy plans
- [Daily News Roundup](https://www.thewire.org.au/day/thursday-19-march-2026): Daily news summary covering SA election, algal bloom, healthcare, housing and indigenous affairs
- [Cyclone Alfred Recovery](https://www.thewire.org.au/story/ex-tropical-cyclone-alfred-causes-rebuilding-challenges-in-nsw): Disaster recovery coverage in Northern NSW with community rebuilding impact

## Labor & Social Justice

- [UTS Staff Strike](https://www.thewire.org.au/story/uts-staff-to-strike-on-thursday): University of Technology Sydney staff strike coverage on enterprise agreement and job security
- [Adelaide Prison Public Control Advocacy](https://www.thewire.org.au/story/union-urge-major-parties-to-return-adelaide-prison-to-public-control): Public Service Association advocacy for Adelaide prison return to public control from Serco

## Environment & Conservation

- [Murray River Water Management](https://www.thewire.org.au/story/feeding-the-mouth-of-the-murray): Murray River water management and conservation coverage across Victoria and South Australia

## Education & Technology

- [La Trobe AI Leadership](https://www.thewire.org.au/story/la-trobe-university-appoints-australias-first-pro-vice-chancellor-in-ai): La Trobe University's appointment of Australia's first AI Pro-Vice-Chancellor in higher education
